correctness.rationale: All 192 maximal geodesics follow from the coordinate-flip path characterization. Each of the eight middle spheres and 32 lifted three-neighborhoods meets every path. Exact standalone code exhausts all 4,368 five-vertex and 8,008 six-vertex subsets; an independent 50-orbit partition replays all 384 automorphisms and checks 48 valid missing-path witnesses. These are exhaustive finite verifications, not samples. The construction and published lower bound both give optimum size six.

value.rationale: This is the full natural minimum-solution space of a newly studied network transversal problem, not a recomputation of gt(Q4). The structural split into eight independent Hamming middle layers and 32 lifted neighborhoods with three matching edges explains two inequivalent geometries among all optimum placements. A finite exact census of all optimum configurations is valuable without a general higher-dimensional theorem.
